description: This file implements a gateway lock mechanism for managing exclusive access to a gateway process, including acquiring and releasing locks, checking process status, and handling cross-platform process command line retrieval.

classes.name: GatewayLockError
classes.description: Custom error class for gateway lock related errors, with optional cause.

methods.name: readLinuxCmdline
methods.description: Reads the command line of a Linux process from /proc/[pid]/cmdline.

methods.name: readWindowsCmdline
methods.description: Reads the command line of a Windows process using wmic.

methods.name: readDarwinCmdline
methods.description: Reads the command line of a macOS/BSD process using ps.

methods.name: readLinuxStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of a Linux process from /proc/[pid]/stat.

methods.name: checkPortFree
methods.description: Checks if a network port is free by attempting a connection.

methods.name: defaultReadProcessCmdline
methods.description: Selects the appropriate process command line reader based on platform.

methods.name: resolveGatewayOwnerStatus
methods.description: Determines if a process owning a lock is alive, dead, or unknown.

methods.name: readLockPayload
methods.description: Reads and parses the lock payload JSON from a lock file.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLockPath
methods.description: Generates the lock file path and config path based on environment and directory.

methods.name: acquireGatewayLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for the gateway process, with retries and stale lock handling.
